purpose: Cross-species comparative dashboard for chromosome-scale rearrangements between Cgar and Cmac, derived from a wfmash 1-to-1 alignment (cs_breakpoints_v1 schema). Each breakpoint renders both species' coordinates, a syntenic-block linking line, and the flanking repeat-element density on both species (drawing from page11's TEfull JSONs already loaded into state.repeatDensity). Spalax-style TE enrichment at breakpoints is the manuscript hook.
